static_functions.name: IsLoaded
static_functions.description: Returns if an Asset is already loaded and cached
static_functions.description_long:
Returns if an Asset is already loaded and cached.

An Asset counts as loaded once an entity, an attached mesh or Assets.LoadAsync loaded it during this session, as the type it was loaded as.

parameters.name: asset_path
parameters.description: The asset reference in the format asset-pack::AssetKey

static_functions.name: LoadAsync
static_functions.description: Loads an Asset in the background, so spawning or attaching it later does not freeze the game
static_functions.description_long:
Loads an Asset in the background, so spawning or attaching it later does not freeze the game.

Entities and attached meshes load their assets right away when created, which can freeze the game for a moment when the asset is big or many are created at once (e.g. dressing several Characters with AddSkeletalMeshAttached).

The asset stays loaded and cached afterwards. Loading the same asset again while it is still loading waits for the same request. The callback always runs on a later tick, never inside this call, even when the asset was already loaded.

parameters.name: asset_path
parameters.description: The asset reference in the format asset-pack::AssetKey

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Called when the asset finished loading

examples.title: Loads a Skeletal Mesh before attaching it
examples.content:
Assets.LoadAsync("my-asset-pack::SK_MyHair", AssetType.SkeletalMesh, function(success)
	if (success and character:IsValid()) then
		character:AddSkeletalMeshAttached("hair", "my-asset-pack::SK_MyHair")
	end
end)

static_functions.description: Manually adds an Asset to be loaded during the Player's loading screen
